EntityOptions.description: Common constructor options for an entity’s identity, transform, vector paint, material and rendering flags. A shape-specific options interface can extend this set.

EntityOptions.label.description: A readable name stored in Entity.LABEL. Use it to identify an object while inspecting a scene.

EntityOptions.visible.description: Choose whether the entity is visible. Hiding changes presentation; destruction and removal remain separate lifecycle operations.

EntityOptions.zIndex.description: Set an explicit rendering order value. This updates Entity.z_index and records an explicit override.

EntityOptions.castShadow.description: Allow this object to contribute to raster shadow maps when the rendering pipeline and light support shadows.

EntityOptions.receiveShadow.description: Allow this object’s raster shading to include shadows from other objects.

EntityOptions.isPickable.description: Choose whether the interaction picking system can identify this object. Visual appearance and pointer handling are separate choices.

EntityOptions.layerMask.description: A bitmask selecting the render layers that contain this entity. Layer zero is represented by bit one; use the layer helpers rather than treating the mask as a layer index.

EntityOptions.isUI.description: Mark this entity as a UI overlay. applyOptions calls setAsUI(false), so this option does not automatically mark its existing children.

EntityOptions.position.description: Set the initial translation in the entity’s parent coordinate system. This is an absolute position rather than a displacement.

EntityOptions.rotation.description: Set an initial orientation with a scalar angle, Euler vector, or Quaternion. Angular inputs use radians.

EntityOptions.scale.description: Set a uniform factor or separate factors for each axis. A value of one preserves the geometry’s original size.

EntityOptions.pivot.description: Set the initial pivot from a world coordinate after applying the starting transform. Pivot synchronization preserves visible placement.

EntityOptions.anchor.description: Choose a persistent normalized bounds reference. The implementation applies this anchor before position and rotation.

EntityOptions.t.description: Set the general normalized animation parameter exposed through Transform. Its visible meaning depends on the shader or entity using it.

EntityOptions.t1.description: Set the first normalized animation variable, commonly used as the beginning of a path reveal range.

EntityOptions.t2.description: Set the second normalized animation variable, commonly used as the end of a path reveal range.

EntityOptions.fill.description: Set the vector interior color. Color.NONE gives an unfilled path. This option changes Paint rather than a mesh’s PBR material.

EntityOptions.stroke.description: Set the vector outline color. Pair it with strokeWidth to make the outline visible.

EntityOptions.strokeWidth.description: Set the outline width in scene units. Camera framing and transform scale affect its apparent thickness.

EntityOptions.opacity.description: Set the paint opacity multiplier. Use the overlap in the paint lab to compare transparent and opaque contributions.

EntityOptions.cap.description: Choose the treatment of both endpoints of an open stroked path. startCap and endCap can choose different endpoint treatments.

EntityOptions.startCap.description: Choose the stroke treatment at the start of an open path.

EntityOptions.endCap.description: Choose the stroke treatment at the end of an open path.

EntityOptions.joint.description: Choose how stroked segments meet at a corner. The join becomes more noticeable with a thick outline or a sharp angle.

EntityOptions.materialColor.description: Set the base color of the entity’s 3D material. It serves a different rendering path from the vector fill color.

EntityOptions.emColor.description: Set the material’s emission color. Combine it with emStrength to control the emitted contribution.

EntityOptions.emStrength.description: Set the strength of the material’s emission contribution.

EntityOptions.roughness.description: Set material roughness, which changes the spread of reflected highlights. Inspect a rotating model to see its effect.

EntityOptions.metallic.description: Set the material’s metallic response. Evaluate it together with the base color and lighting.

EntityOptions.transmission.description: Set the material transmission amount for renderers that support transmission. This is separate from vector paint opacity.

EntityOptions.ior.description: Set the material index of refraction used by rendering paths that model refraction.

EntityOptions.frustumCull.description: Choose whether camera frustum culling can skip this object. Disable it deliberately for objects whose effective bounds cannot represent their visible contribution.

Entity.constructor.description: Create the scene-graph node, connect transform mutations to world-matrix invalidation, and apply any supplied EntityOptions. Creating the entity alone does not attach it to a scene.

Entity.visible.description: Read or assign the entity’s visibility flag. This accessor does not remove children, stop external timers, or dispose GPU resources.

Entity.anchor.description: Read or assign the persistent local bounds anchor. Assignment converts the supplied vector with Vec3.cast and invalidates the anchor; assigning null clears it.

Entity.z_index.description: Read or assign the paint’s z-index. Assignment records an explicit local ordering choice.

Entity.setStrokeColor.description: Change the vector outline color through the entity’s Paint and return the entity for chaining. Call Scene.invalidate after an interactive change if the scene is otherwise idle.

EntityEventMap.description: The entity event map is the InteractionEventMap contract under an entity-facing name. Its keys select the payload type for pointer and interaction callbacks.

EntityEventType.description: The set of interaction event names accepted by entity event registration. Follow InteractionEventType for the underlying event contract.

Updater.description: A callback shape for entity updates. It may take no arguments or read scene time and delta time in milliseconds. Prefer Entity.always when you need a managed handle or scheduling options.

Paint.setStrokeColor.description: Set the outline color and return this Paint for chaining. The stroke setter marks its override and upload flags.

Paint.setStrokeWidth.description: Set the outline width and return this Paint for chaining. This changes styling while leaving the original vector path intact.

Paint.version.description: A change-tracking revision for this paint state. Setting UPDATE_FLAG to true allocates a new global revision so buffer synchronization can detect fresh values.

hex.description: Create a Color from a three- or six-digit hexadecimal string. Pass opacity as the second argument: hex("#38bdf8", 0.2). The helper’s implementation does not decode an eight-digit RGBA string.

CameraModel.PERSPECTIVE.description: Use perspective projection, where equally sized objects at different depths can have different apparent sizes. Camera.fov controls the viewing angle.

CameraModel.ORTHOGRAPHIC.description: Use orthographic projection, where depth does not introduce perspective size changes. Camera.orthoScale controls framing.

Entity.setT.description: Set the general animation parameter and request a redraw. The current method takes one argument; use setT1 and setT2 separately for a draw range.
